title: Sunday deals: Le Creuset 24cm casserole for £203, a Ninja Creami for £202 and the Dyson Supersonic Origin for £199.99
description: A Le Creuset casserole under last year's Black Friday price, £47 off the Ninja Creami Deluxe, Dyson hair tools at target prices and an £85 advent calendar.
intro:
Today's list leans towards the kitchen and the dressing table. The standout is a Le Creuset Signature 24cm casserole on Amazon for just over £203 in Caribbean blue, which is already below what it sold for last Black Friday. There's also £47 off the Ninja Creami Deluxe, and the two Dyson Origin hair tools are sitting at the prices we'd normally wait for November to see.

A quick steer: the Le Creuset and the GLOSSYBOX advent calendar are worth buying now, as cheap colours and calendars tend to sell out rather than get cheaper. The KitchenAid and the Creami are fair prices, but could drop a little further on Black Friday. We could only confirm seven deals today, so it's a shorter list. Prices were checked on 25 October.

deals.name: Le Creuset Signature cast iron round casserole, 24cm (4.2 litres), Caribbean
deals.note: About £20 under last year's Black Friday price for this size. The 24cm is the one most households should buy. The £335 is what other colours cost at full price, and Amazon's Le Creuset prices change by colour, so check you're on Caribbean before you buy.

deals.name: Ninja CREAMi Deluxe 10-in-1 ice cream and frozen drink maker (NC501UK), Black
deals.note: £47 off the RRP. The Deluxe has bigger tubs than the original Creami and can make slushies and frozen drinks too. A solid Christmas present for families. Ninja often cuts the Creami again in November, so there's no rush if you can wait.

deals.name: Dyson Supersonic Origin hair dryer, Nickel/Copper
deals.note: AO is 99p cheaper at £199, Very matches Argos, and Amazon is £249. Around £200 is the price our Dyson guide suggested waiting for. It has been cheaper on occasion, so a Black Friday dip isn't ruled out.

deals.name: Dyson Airwrap Multi-Styler Origin, Nickel/Copper
deals.note: Within £1 of what Boots charged last Black Friday, so there's little reason to wait. AO is 99p cheaper at £299. The Prussian Blue version costs £100 more at Currys and Boots, for the same styler.

deals.name: KitchenAid Artisan 4.8L tilt-head stand mixer (5KSM125), Empire Red
deals.note: The classic red Artisan. It was £345 on Amazon last Cyber Monday, so waiting might save you about £15. Other colours cost more today, with black at £398 at Argos.

deals.name: GLOSSYBOX 2026 Advent Calendar (worth over £645)
deals.note: Under £4 a door, and the best value for money of the calendars we compared. Calendars sell out more often than they get cheaper, so this is one to buy now if you want it.

deals.name: Le Creuset Signature cast iron round casserole, 20cm (2.4 litres), Caribbean
deals.note: The smaller size, right for one or two people or for sides and sauces. £265 is what other colours cost at full price, so the saving depends on Caribbean blue suiting your kitchen.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

**Buy now:** the Le Creuset casseroles. Both are well under the full price other colours sell for, and the 24cm is already cheaper than last Black Friday. Our new [Le Creuset Black Friday guide](/guides/le-creuset-black-friday-deals-2026/) has target prices for every popular size. Buy the GLOSSYBOX calendar now too. Our [beauty advent calendars compared](/guides/beauty-advent-calendars-2026/) guide shows how it stacks up against Liberty, Charlotte Tilbury and the rest.

**Fine now, might drop:** the KitchenAid and the Creami. Both are fair prices, but Black Friday could take another £15 to £30 off. See our new [KitchenAid Black Friday guide](/guides/kitchenaid-black-friday-deals-2026/) and the [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/) for the prices to wait for.

**Dyson hair tools:** both Origin models are at the prices we'd expect on Black Friday. Our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) covers the rest of the range.

Amazon's Black Friday prices often need Prime. Our [Amazon Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time the trial. For everything else, see [Black Friday 2026: what to buy now, what to wait for, and the traps to avoid](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) and [every Black Friday guide](/black-friday/).
